name: Alba Real Estate Group
tagline: Mortgage guidance you can trust, from your first home to your next refinance.
disclaimer: This is not a commitment to lend. All loans are subject to credit approval, underwriting guidelines and property eligibility. Programs, rates and terms are subject to change without notice.

team.name: Jorge Alba
team.bio: I've spent the past six years helping families and business owners find the right financing for their homes and investments. I have experience with everything from traditional mortgages to bank statement, DSCR, and fix-and-flip loans. I enjoy finding solutions that make sense for each client's situation and helping them reach their real estate goals.

team.name: Chloe Alba
team.bio: Over the past year, I've worked with families, first-time homebuyers, and clients relocating to Colorado, helping them navigate the real estate market with confidence. I understand that buying a home is a significant decision, and I'm dedicated to providing thoughtful guidance, honest communication, and a personalized experience. I enjoy building lasting relationships with my clients and helping them find a home that aligns with their needs, lifestyle, and long-term goals.
